input.quote: 28.1 This Agreement is governed exclusively by Singapore law, and the courts of Singapore have exclusive jurisdiction.
input.rationale: Clause 28.1 selects Singapore law with exclusive Singapore courts — outside the accepted set (New York, Delaware, California, England and Wales) and an exclusive foreign venue, i.e. walk-away territory — and it conflicts with 28.2, which already vests exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts in New York County, New York. The minimal cure is to swap the governing-law words in 28.1 to the laws of the State of New York and delete the conflicting Singapore forum wording (no need to restate the forum, which 28.2 already supplies), and to confine the temporary-injunctive-relief carve-out in 28.2 to those same New York County courts so law and forum form one permitted corresponding pair. The 28.3 escalation process is unchanged and acceptable.
